layout.arrangement: White slide enclosed by a thin dark-red rectangular frame. Title in bold red at top-left with a yellow circular slide-number badge '37' at top-right. Below the title, three columns: left column holds a small green-boxed 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' flowchart; center column holds a larger green-boxed 'Multi-Head Attention' flowchart; right column holds a large full Transformer (Encoder + Decoder) architecture panel. Dashed red funnel lines run from the left and center boxes, converging on a red-circled 'Multi-Head Attention' block inside the encoder. A solid black strip (video player progress bar) spans the very bottom edge.

layout.hierarchy: Visually dominant: (1) the large right-hand Transformer diagram (largest area, most colors); (2) the bold red title; (3) the center Multi-Head Attention diagram; (4) the left Scaled Dot-Product Attention diagram (smallest). Red is the attention color (title, frame, pin, highlight circle, dashed connectors); green outlines group the two left diagrams; the yellow '37' badge is a small accent.

visual_elements.description: Left diagram 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention': vertical bottom-to-top flowchart inside a green rounded-rectangle outline with small green square handles at its corners. From bottom: three small circles labeled Q (red fill, white letter), K (dark-blue fill, white letter), V (dark-blue fill, white letter); black arrows up into a lavender box 'MatMul'; arrow up to yellow box 'Scale'; arrow up to pink box 'Mask (opt.)'; arrow up to light-green box 'SoftMax'; arrow up to a second lavender box 'MatMul'; output arrow exits the top of the box. A long straight skip/residual arrow runs up the right side from the bottom input lines to the top 'MatMul' box.

Center diagram 'Multi-Head Attention': vertical bottom-to-top flowchart inside a green rounded-rectangle outline with corner handles. From bottom: three circles V (dark blue), K (dark blue), Q (red); three side-by-side white boxes each labeled 'Linear', each drawn with 2-3 gray offset stacked-card copies behind it (indicating h parallel heads); black arrows converge upward into one large mauve-pink box labeled 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' (also drawn with stacked shadow copies); arrow up to yellow box 'Concat'; arrow up to white box 'Linear'; output arrow exits the top. A curly brace with italic label 'h' sits at the right of the stacked copies.

Right diagram: full Transformer architecture inside a large green-bordered rectangle split into a peach encoder panel (left, labeled 'Encoder' in red italic at its top-left) and a light-green decoder panel (right, labeled 'Decoder' in red italic at its top-right). Encoder column bottom-to-top: thick red up-arrow labeled 'Inputs' below the panel; orange box 'Input Embedding'; tan box 'Positional Encoding' with a small clock icon at its left feeding a curved arrow into the embedding line; orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' (heavily highlighted, see below) with small circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) beneath it; orange box 'Add & Norm' [?] (likely obscured behind the red highlight circle); orange box 'Feed Forward'; orange box 'Add & Norm' at top; connecting arrow from the encoder top curves right toward the decoder. Decoder column bottom-to-top: yellow box 'Outputs (shifted right)'; orange box 'Output Embedding'; tan box 'Positional Encoding' with clock icon at its right feeding a curved arrow; orange box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles beneath; orange box 'Add & Norm'; orange box 'Multi-Head Attention' with V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) circles beneath (K,V fed from encoder); orange box 'Add & Norm'; orange box 'Feed Forward'; orange box 'Add & Norm'; green box 'Linear'; green box 'Softmax'; thick red up-arrow; yellow box 'Output' with black text 'Probabilities' directly beneath it. A gray circle label 'Nx' sits at the right edge of the decoder stack mid-height. A dashed red curved arrow runs down the right edge of the decoder from near 'Output'/'Probabilities' to 'Outputs (shifted right)'.

Emphasis overlays: a large solid red circle (with a soft yellow glow ring) placed over the encoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' block; a red balloon/map-pin shape with white bold text 'WE ARE HERE' floats above-left of the block, tip pointing down at it; two pairs of dashed red lines run from the right edge of the left 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' box and from the right edge of the center 'Multi-Head Attention' box, converging on the highlighted block like a funnel.

imagery: Red cartoon balloon/map-pin with white bold text 'WE ARE HERE', tip pointing down at the encoder's highlighted Multi-Head Attention block.
Two small analog clock icons (white clock face with hands) inside the tan 'Positional Encoding' boxes (encoder-left and decoder-right).
Stacked-card gray shadow copies behind the 'Linear' boxes and the 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' box in the center diagram, suggesting h stacked parallel layers.
No photographs or clip-art images otherwise; all visuals are vector-style diagram shapes.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). The title is the largest text (~32-36pt), bold, bright red. Diagram section headers ('Scaled Dot-Product Attention', 'Multi-Head Attention', 'Encoder', 'Decoder') are bold italic red (~14-16pt). Block labels are small (~9-11pt) black regular sans-serif inside outlined boxes. 'WE ARE HERE' is white bold on red. The slide number '37' is red bold inside a yellow circle. No serif fonts; no all-caps except 'WE ARE HERE'; no numbered bullets anywhere on the slide.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built (there are no bullets to reveal). recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and draw a dark-red (#C00000) rectangle outline inset ~0.15 inch from all edges as a frame.
2. Add title text box at top-left: 'Transformer Blocks (stacked over Multi-Head)', Arial bold ~32pt, color #CC0000.
3. Add a yellow (#FFD966) oval ~0.5 inch diameter at top-right containing red bold text '37'.
4. Build the left diagram: green (#2E7D32) rounded-rectangle outline ~2.2 x 3.6 inch at left-middle; above it place red bold-italic two-line header 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'. Inside, stack bottom-to-top: three 0.35 inch circles Q (red #D32F2F), K (blue #1A1AB8), V (blue #1A1AB8) with white letters; lavender (#B39DDB) box 'MatMul'; yellow (#FFF176) box 'Scale'; pink (#F8BBD0) box 'Mask (opt.)'; green (#A5D6A7) box 'SoftMax'; lavender box 'MatMul'; connect with black up-arrows; add a long skip arrow on the right from the bottom input line to the top MatMul; add an output arrow exiting the top.
5. Build the center diagram: green rounded-rectangle outline ~3.2 x 4.2 inch at center; red bold-italic header 'Multi-Head Attention' above. Inside bottom-to-top: circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red); three white 'Linear' boxes side by side, each with 2-3 gray offset shadow copies; large mauve-pink (#D8A0B8) box 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' also with stacked shadow copies; yellow 'Concat' box; white 'Linear' box; black up-arrows throughout; curly brace plus italic 'h' label at the right of the stacked copies.
6. Build the right transformer panel: large green-bordered rectangle ~5 x 6 inch on the right half; fill left ~45% peach (#FBE5D6) with red italic 'Encoder' at its top-left, right ~55% light green (#D5E8D4) with red italic 'Decoder' at its top-right.
7. Encoder stack bottom-to-top: red block arrow up labeled 'Inputs' below the panel; orange (#E8A33D) box 'Input Embedding'; tan (#C9A66B) box 'Positional Encoding' with a small clock icon at its left and a curved arrow into the embedding line; orange 'Multi-Head Attention' with V/K/Q circles beneath; orange 'Add & Norm'; orange 'Feed Forward'; orange 'Add & Norm' at top; black up-arrows between all; arrow from encoder top curving right toward the decoder.
8. Decoder stack bottom-to-top: yellow 'Outputs (shifted right)'; orange 'Output Embedding'; tan 'Positional Encoding' with clock icon at its right and curved arrow; orange 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with V/K/Q circles; orange 'Add & Norm'; orange 'Multi-Head Attention' with V/K/Q circles (K,V fed from encoder); orange 'Add & Norm'; orange 'Feed Forward'; orange 'Add & Norm'; green (#A5D6A7) 'Linear'; green 'Softmax'; thick red up-arrow; yellow 'Output' box with black text 'Probabilities' just below it. Add a gray (#A6A6A6) circle label 'Nx' at the right edge mid-stack.
9. Add emphasis overlays: a large solid red (#D32F2F) circle with a yellow glow over the encoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' block; a red balloon/pin shape above-left with white bold 'WE ARE HERE' pointing down at it; dashed red lines from the right edges of the left and center green boxes converging on this block; a dashed red curved arrow down the decoder's right edge from 'Output' to 'Outputs (shifted right)'.
10. Optionally add a full-width black rectangle ~0.25 inch tall at the very bottom edge to mimic the video progress bar (it is player UI, not slide content).
